originalObservations: A very quiet blue wreck silhouette: low long slab hull, slightly leaning mast with one crossbar, and a small raised cabin. Front blue value varies with height but broad surfaces are plain and abrupt.
The original forms are visually thin in depth and mechanical, with sharp boxy ends. Its low contrast blue palette and restrained background role matter more than its original part count.
targetObservations: The fixed target offers softened worn timber volumes, a readable broken hull opening, more convincing rounded mast and crossbar, coarse plank separation, a small cabin, rope and selective marine accretion.
Blue timber remains the main identity; warm exposed wood, muted green weed and a few pale attachments can clarify materials without taking over.

Target fringe glow/speckles and strong golden edge accents are image artifacts or directional light suggestions, not native deliverables. Its tiny debris and high detail density are not requirements at phone size.
styleObservations: The global plant reference has legible broad planes, soft rounded edges, rich simple color separation and broad gentle highlights. Translate the sculpted volume and clean grouping without importing the plant palette or foreground brightness.
